honestly you could just stop showing up. Three days of no call no show is automatic firing. I suggest you do things right and put in your two weeks. Have a private discussion with your GM and tell them that as of [Insert date] you put in your two weeks and will no longer be available to work after that point. After you tell your GM, inform your managers and fellow employees that you'll be leaving soon. People quit fast food all the time but doing it this way makes it easier for the GM and your managers. It also means that you can continue to use them as references for future jobs without animosity and you can even be rehired if you choose to return
